describe.description: A large quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile standing on a plain light background. The body, head, legs and small rear tuft are covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the legs and lighter on the face and underside. The head is broad with a blunt snout, black nostrils, small dark eyes, a slightly open mouth, and two small rounded furry ears on top. Two dark, smooth, pointed horns project from the face, a large forward-curving horn on the tip of the snout and a much smaller horn on the forehead between the eyes. The entire back from behind the neck to the rump is covered by a large, glossy, dark brown domed shell divided into a smooth anterior section over the shoulders and a larger posterior section with fine parallel longitudinal ridges, with a visible seam between them and a segmented lower margin. The animal stands on four thick muscular legs ending in broad paws with long curved claws, and a small furry tail tuft is visible at the rear beneath the edge of the shell.

describe.description: A large four-legged furry mammal standing in side view facing right. Its body, head, legs and short tail are covered in long shaggy brown fur with a bear-like head, muzzle, and small rounded ears. A long curved dark horn projects up from the tip of its nose and a small pointed bump sits between its eyes above the muzzle. The entire back from behind the head to the rump is covered by a smooth dark brown domed shell in two sections, the rear section with fine lengthwise grooves and a rim of small rectangular plates around the lower edge.
